procurement_key_commitments: EU data residency (Frankfurt) guaranteed in SLA
Quarterly full-data export right under DPA
Named CSM assigned for first 12 months
procurement_negotiation_leverage: 40-seat deal is modest volume — negotiate multi-year discount (15-20% off list for 2-year commit)
Zoho list EUR18,240/yr; competitor HubSpot quote EUR24,000 is a live BATNA to present
Peak-season constraint (October deadline) gives urgency — request expedited implementation support at no cost
Request free onboarding/training package (24 training hours already scoped) in lieu of price concession
Export clause already confirmed in GDPR DPA — use it to de-risk lock-in and soften contract term resistance

procurement_risks.risk: Contract auto-renewal clause locks in a price increase before review
procurement_risks.mitigation: Insert 90-day pre-renewal opt-out window and cap annual price uplift at CPI+2%

procurement_risks.risk: NetSuite connector dependency creates single-vendor choke point mid-rollout
procurement_risks.mitigation: Confirm connector SLA and support tier before contract signature; add break clause if connector is discontinued

procurement_risks.risk: Zoho product maturity risk may require mid-term upgrade to higher tier, inflating cost
procurement_risks.mitigation: Negotiate tier-upgrade pricing caps at time of initial contract; document current-tier feature set in Schedule A

procurement_risks.risk: Phase-1 go-live (2026-07-01) leaves <4 weeks from contract signature to deployment start
procurement_risks.mitigation: Begin procurement process immediately; target contract execution by 2026-06-20 to protect schedule

procurement_risks.risk: Subprocessor substitution by Zoho could affect GDPR compliance mid-term
procurement_risks.mitigation: 30-day notice clause already confirmed; include right-to-terminate if replacement subprocessor is unacceptable
